subject: How do I rotate an API key?
body: Hi, our security policy says we need to rotate keys every quarter. Where in Quillstack do I rotate the API key for our workspace, and does the old key stop working right away? Thanks, Dana

subject: Charged for 14 seats but we only have 11 users
body: Our September invoice shows 14 seats. We removed three people from the workspace on August 30. Can you explain the charge and let me know whether we get a credit? Invoice number is on the PDF but it also still says 14 in the header.

subject: QS-1042 when rotating a key that is only 30 days old
body: Calling POST /v1/api-keys/rotate returns {"error": "QS-1042", "message": "key rotation not due"}. The key was created on August 17. Your docs say rotation is allowed any time on Team. It used to work in July. Repro: create key, wait a day, call rotate.
